d.en: Kiddy Kong (ディンキーコング, Dinky Kong in Japan) is a 3 year old Kong and the youngest member of the Kong Family. Kiddy plays the role of the co-star in the games Donkey Kong Country 3 and Donkey Kong Land III.

d.fr: Shulk (Japanese: シュルク, Shuruku; English dub: /ˈʃʊlk/) is the main playable character and the protagonist of Xenoblade Chronicles.
d.en: Shulk (Japanese: シュルク, Shuruku; English dub: /ˈʃʊlk/) is the main playable character and the protagonist of Xenoblade Chronicles.

d.fr: The Pyro is a pyromaniac of indeterminate origin who has a burning passion for all things fire related. As shown in Meet the Pyro, they appear to be insane and delusional, visualizing themself in a utopian fantasy world known as Pyroland.

d.fr: Sally Smithson or "The Nurse" is one of 41 Killers currently featured in Dead by Daylight.
d.en: Sally Smithson or "The Nurse" is one of 41 Killers currently featured in Dead by Daylight.

d.fr: Emiel Regis Rohellec Terzieff-Godefroy, better known simply as Regis, was a very powerful higher vampire, and more than four hundred years old when he first met Geralt of Rivia. He was the barber-surgeon of Dillingen.
d.en: Emiel Regis Rohellec Terzieff-Godefroy, better known simply as Regis, was a very powerful higher vampire, and more than four hundred years old when he first met Geralt of Rivia. He was the barber-surgeon of Dillingen.

d.fr: Alarak is the highlord of the Tal'darim. He was previously the First Ascendant in the Chain of Ascension under Highlord Ma'lash. During the End War, Alarak used his alliance with the Daelaam to overthrow and replace Ma'lash, and turned the Tal'darim against Amon.

d.fr: Beppi The Clown is a boss in Cuphead that is fought in the Carnival Kerfuffle level of Inkwell Isle Two.
d.en: Beppi The Clown is a boss in Cuphead that is fought in the Carnival Kerfuffle level of Inkwell Isle Two.

d.fr: Gooper Blooper is a giant Blooper with large and longer tentacles. He first appears as a boss in Super Mario Sunshine, where he appears in the levels Ricco Harbor and Noki Bay. He uses his tentacles to smack Mario, draining his health.
d.en: Gooper Blooper is a giant Blooper with large and longer tentacles. He first appears as a boss in Super Mario Sunshine, where he appears in the levels Ricco Harbor and Noki Bay. He uses his tentacles to smack Mario, draining his health.

d.fr: Achilles Davenport (c. 1710 – 1781) was a member of the West Indies Brotherhood of Assassins and later the founder and first Mentor of the Colonial Brotherhood, a position he held from 1746 until his forced retirement in 1763.
d.en: Achilles Davenport (c. 1710 – 1781) was a member of the West Indies Brotherhood of Assassins and later the founder and first Mentor of the Colonial Brotherhood, a position he held from 1746 until his forced retirement in 1763.

d.fr: They say ruin brings about creation. So, what then would another Keyblade War bring? When the darkness falls, will we be found worthy of the precious light the legend speaks of? I must have these answers.

d.fr: Nazeem is a Redguard citizen in The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim who resides in the upstairs room of The Drunken Huntsman. He, along with his wife Ahlam, owns Chillfurrow Farm, which is located south of Whiterun.

d.en: Sean MacGuire is a recurring character in the Red Dead series, appearing as a supporting character in Red Dead Redemption 2 and as a stranger in Red Dead Online.

d.fr: Escharum is a legendary veteran Jiralhanae male who serves as a War Chief within the Banished. He is the leading member of the Hand of Atriox, a group of deadly Spartan Killers, current second in command of the Banished and was Atriox's old mentor.

d.fr: Inspector Chelmey is a recurring character appearing in the Professor Layton series. He is a police inspector who works for Scotland Yard, and serves as the main inspector Layton works with for the first trilogy of the series.
d.en: Inspector Chelmey is a recurring character appearing in the Professor Layton series. He is a police inspector who works for Scotland Yard, and serves as the main inspector Layton works with for the first trilogy of the series.

d.fr: Tiny Kong is a female Kong from the Donkey Kong (series). She is Dixie Kong’s younger sister and, as such, she has two male cousins, baby Kiddy Kong and his older brother Chunky Kong.
d.en: Tiny Kong is a female Kong from the Donkey Kong (series). She is Dixie Kong’s younger sister and, as such, she has two male cousins, baby Kiddy Kong and his older brother Chunky Kong.

d.fr: Malcolm Landgraab (or Malcolm Landgrabb) is a pre-made Sim who appears throughout various games of The Sims series. He is the first ever Landgraab featured in The Sims universe (but not the earliest known member of his dynasty), since his first apparition in "SimCity 3000".
d.en: Malcolm Landgraab (or Malcolm Landgrabb) is a pre-made Sim who appears throughout various games of The Sims series. He is the first ever Landgraab featured in The Sims universe (but not the earliest known member of his dynasty), since his first apparition in "SimCity 3000".

d.fr: Judd (Japanese: ジャッジくん Jajji-kun / Judge-kun) is a cat in Splatoon, Splatoon 2, and Splatoon 3. Unlike other characters, he seems to play a role in Splatoon's story that remains a mystery. In multiplayer, he plays the role of referee in Turf Wars.

d.fr: Eliza Pancakes (née Hastings) is a pre-made playable Sim residing in Willow Creek, one of the worlds shipped with The Sims 4. She lives with her husband, Bob. Eliza and Bob also have a son named Iggy, who was uploaded into Gallery shortly after the toddlers update.

d.fr: Proto Man, known as Blues (ブルース, Burūsu) in Japan, is a recurring character in the original Mega Man series. He is the first of the Light Numbers ever created by Dr. Light, even before Mega Man himself, making him technically the older brother of Mega Man and Roll.

d.fr: The firstborn son of the Archduke of Rosaria. Though all expected him to inherit the Phoenix's flames and awaken as its Dominant, destiny instead chose his younger brother Joshua to bear this burden. In search of a role of his own, Clive dedicated himself to mastering the blade.

d.fr: Trish is a demon created by Mundus who strangely resembles Dante and Vergil's mother, Eva. After his defeat by the hands of Dante, she later joined Devil May Cry and became a devil hunter alongside him.
d.en: Trish is a demon created by Mundus who strangely resembles Dante and Vergil's mother, Eva. After his defeat by the hands of Dante, she later joined Devil May Cry and became a devil hunter alongside him.

d.fr: Skelly is a Bloodless "employed" by the House of Hades as a training dummy. While Skelly claims to be on the House's payroll, he refuses to reveal who hired him and is similarly unwilling to discuss his past, instead preferring to play various pranks on Zagreus.

d.fr: Brother, you are a warrior. I can see that. You trained your whole life for this. And you have won battles that lesser men have called unwinnable, yes? But while you were sharpening your sword, do you know how I prepared for today? I learned. I know your language...
